nexscope/billing.instruction: Check current pricing before execution. Do not automatically retry a paid call.

nexscope/inputExamples.prompt: Keep the product consistent and generate a clean white-background ecommerce hero image.

description: Generate and edit ecommerce images with Nano Banana 2.1, with improved text layout and consistency across editing rounds. The model is fixed by this API, so provider must not be supplied in the request.

imageUrls.description: Optional public reference image URLs. Omit this field for text-to-image generation, or provide references for image-to-image generation. When supplied, provide 1 to 14 JPG, PNG, or WEBP images; each image must not exceed 20 MB.

outputNum.description: Number of images to generate. Valid range: 1 to 10; defaults to 1.

prompt.description: Generation prompt describing the target image, scene, composition, style, and constraints. Maximum 5000 characters.
prompt.example: Keep the product consistent and generate a clean white-background ecommerce hero image.

resolution.description: Output resolution. Supported values: 1K, 2K, or 4K; defaults to 1K.

name: nexscope_banana_2_1_image_generation
title: Nano Banana 2.1 Image Generation
